description: List the associations from one CRM object to another object type.

after.description: Pagination cursor from the previous page's response, to fetch the next page.

limit.description: Maximum number of associations to return in one page.

objectId.description: The ID of the source object whose associations to list.

objectType.description: The CRM object type of the source object, such as contacts, companies, deals, or tickets.

toObjectType.description: The object type of the associated objects to list, such as contacts, companies, deals, or tickets.

name: hubspot_list_associations
